newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Gas Oil/Jet - Diesel market steady to firm.
newsitem.headline: Asia Gas Oil/Jet - Diesel market steady to firm.

text.p: Singapore gas oil market was steady to slightly firmer as two physical cargoes were heard traded while the swaps market was quiet ahead of the long weekend, traders said on Thursday.
A 200,000-barrel cargo was sold by a trader at $25.30 per barrel for Feb 24-28 lifting fob, higher than the two deals seen on Wednesday at $25.20 and $24.90 per barrel.
Traders said the physical gas oil market, like the swaps market, is also in contago with a bid for early March lifting seen at $25.50.
Another 25,000-tonne lot was heard traded today at parity to Singapore spot quotes for lifting next week, up from recent deals seen at discounts.
February gas oil swaps rose slightly to $25.40/$25/60 a barrel, from Wednesday's $25.25/$25.35.
Traders expect the physical and swaps gas oil market to remain steady when the market reopens next week.
India's additional tender for March gas oil and Nepal's gas oil and kerosene tender for March closes on Thursday.
Jet fuel also remained steady with a bid seen for 100,000 barrels at $31.00 a barrel for Feb 21-25 lifting fob.
